title: First-Line Supervisors of Food Preparation and Serving Workers
description: Directly supervise and coordinate activities of workers engaged in preparing and serving food.

projection.title: First-line supervisors of food preparation and serving workers

tasks.text: Resolve customer complaints regarding food service.
tasks.rationale: interpersonal — Satisfaction requires human relationship and accountability

dwas.name: Communicate with customers to resolve complaints or ensure satisfaction.
dwas.gwa_name: Performing for or Working Directly with the Public

tasks.text: Train workers in food preparation, and in service, sanitation, and safety procedures.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Food prep training is hands-on demonstration

dwas.name: Train food preparation or food service personnel.

tasks.text: Assign duties, responsibilities, and work stations to employees in accordance with work requirements.
tasks.rationale: interpersonal — Coordinating food service staff is live supervisory work

dwas.name: Coordinate activities of food service staff.

tasks.text: Present bills and accept payments.
tasks.rationale: data analysis — Billing and payment processing largely automated

dwas.name: Process customer bills or payments.

tasks.text: Perform various financial activities, such as cash handling, deposit preparation, and payroll.
tasks.rationale: interpersonal — Food service management is live operational leadership

dwas.name: Manage food service operations or parts of operations.

tasks.text: Supervise and participate in kitchen and dining area cleaning activities.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Food area cleaning requires physical labor

dwas.name: Clean food preparation areas, facilities, or equipment.

tasks.text: Recommend measures for improving work procedures and worker performance to increase service quality and enhance job safety.
tasks.rationale: decision support — Broad HR work needs human judgment and accountability

dwas.name: Perform human resources activities.

tasks.text: Specify food portions and courses, production and time sequences, and workstation and equipment arrangements.
tasks.rationale: decision support — Timing coordination aided by AI; kitchen execution human

dwas.name: Coordinate timing of food production activities.

tasks.text: Control inventories of food, equipment, smallware, and liquor, and report shortages to designated personnel.
tasks.rationale: data analysis — Inventory tracking and reorder logic largely automatable

dwas.name: Maintain food, beverage, or equipment inventories.

tasks.text: Observe and evaluate workers and work procedures to ensure quality standards and service, and complete disciplinary write-ups.
tasks.rationale: decision support — Broad HR work needs human judgment and accountability

dwas.name: Monitor food services operations to ensure procedures are followed.
Perform human resources activities.

tasks.text: Analyze operational problems, such as theft and wastage, and establish procedures to alleviate these problems.
tasks.rationale: interpersonal — Food service management is live operational leadership

dwas.name: Manage food service operations or parts of operations.

tasks.text: Inspect supplies, equipment, and work areas to ensure efficient service and conformance to standards.
tasks.rationale: visual inspection — Physical conformance inspection of facilities/equipment

dwas.name: Inspect facilities, equipment or supplies to ensure conformance to standards.

tasks.text: Greet and seat guests, and present menus and wine lists.
tasks.rationale: interpersonal — Menu presentation is live service interaction

dwas.name: Present food or beverage information or menus to customers.
dwas.gwa_name: Communicating with People Outside the Organization

dwas.name: Assist customers with seating arrangements.

tasks.text: Evaluate new products for usefulness and suitability.
tasks.rationale: visual inspection — Material quality often needs hands-on or visual inspection

dwas.name: Evaluate quality of materials or products.
dwas.gwa_name: Judging the Qualities of Objects, Services, or People

tasks.text: Compile and balance cash receipts at the end of the day or shift.
tasks.rationale: data analysis — Balancing receipts is arithmetic, human handles discrepancies

dwas.name: Balance receipts.

tasks.text: Forecast staff, equipment, and supply requirements, based on a master menu.
tasks.rationale: data analysis — Food prep estimates from menus; chef adjusts

dwas.name: Estimate supplies, ingredients, or staff requirements for food preparation activities.

tasks.text: Assess nutritional needs of patients, plan special menus, supervise the assembly of regular and special diet trays, and oversee the delivery of food trolleys to hospital patients.
tasks.rationale: text generation — Menu drafts aided; cost and kitchen constraints human

dwas.name: Plan menu options.

tasks.text: Record production, operational, and personnel data on specified forms.
tasks.rationale: data analysis — Record production data into structured logs

dwas.name: Record operational or production data.

tasks.text: Perform personnel actions, such as hiring and firing staff, providing employee orientation and training, and conducting supervisory activities, such as creating work schedules or organizing employee time sheets.
tasks.rationale: decision support — Broad HR work needs human judgment and accountability

dwas.name: Train food preparation or food service personnel.
Perform human resources activities.

tasks.text: Estimate ingredients and supplies required to prepare a recipe.
tasks.rationale: data analysis — Food prep estimates from menus; chef adjusts

dwas.name: Estimate supplies, ingredients, or staff requirements for food preparation activities.

tasks.text: Purchase or requisition supplies and equipment needed to ensure quality and timely delivery of services.
tasks.rationale: decision support — Ordering via systems automatable; human approves spend

dwas.name: Order materials, supplies, or equipment.

tasks.text: Perform food preparation and serving duties, such as carving meat, preparing flambe dishes, or serving wine and liquor.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Hands-on food cutting

dwas.name: Cut cooked or raw foods.
Prepare foods for cooking or serving.

tasks.text: Schedule parties and take reservations.
tasks.rationale: data analysis — AI books reservations via tools; human handles issues

dwas.name: Schedule dining reservations.

tasks.text: Develop departmental objectives, budgets, policies, procedures, and strategies.
tasks.rationale: interpersonal — Food service management is live operational leadership

dwas.name: Manage food service operations or parts of operations.

tasks.text: Conduct meetings and collaborate with other personnel for menu planning, serving arrangements, and related details.
tasks.rationale: text generation — Menu drafts aided; cost and kitchen constraints human

dwas.name: Plan menu options.

tasks.text: Develop equipment maintenance schedules and arrange for repairs.
tasks.rationale: data analysis — AI plans maintenance timing; human confirms constraints

dwas.name: Schedule equipment maintenance.
